en.headline: John Lee meets AFC president and outlines five-year sports strategy
en.dek: The Chief Executive told Shaikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa that Hong Kong would strengthen support for team sports and seek more top international football events with Kai Tak Sports Park.
body: Chief Executive John Lee met Asian Football Confederation president Shaikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa at Government House on Monday and briefed him on the sports development strategy in Hong Kong’s first five-year plan.

Lee said the government would promote sport through popularisation, elite development, mega-events, professionalism and commercialisation, and would strengthen support for team sports in line with the national drive for football, basketball and volleyball. He thanked the confederation for decades of support for local football.

The Chief Executive noted that Hong Kong had successfully hosted a number of Asian Football Confederation club and international matches, including the recently completed 2026 FIFA Asean Challenge Cup final. With the city’s role as a bridge between the mainland and international sports and the facilities at Kai Tak Sports Park, he looked forward to closer cooperation with the Hong Kong Football Association and the AFC to bring more top-level events.
Culture, Sports and Tourism Secretary Rosanna Law, Hong Kong Football Association president Timothy Fok and chairman Kenneth Fok also attended the meeting.

zh.headline: 李家超會晤亞洲足協會長 介紹五年規劃體育策略
zh.dek: 行政長官向Shaikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa表示，政府將加強隊際運動支援，並期待藉助啟德體育園帶來更多頂級國際足球盛事。
body: 行政長官李家超星期一在特首辦與亞洲足球協會會長Shaikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa會面，並向對方介紹《香港第一個五年規劃》所訂立的體育發展策略。
李家超表示，特區政府致力推動體育發展，落實體育普及化、精英化、盛事化、專業化和產業化，並正加強推動隊際運動發展的支援，以配合國家推廣包括足球在內的「三大球」發展方向。他感謝亞洲足協數十年來一直支持本地足球發展。
行政長官指出，香港多年來成功舉辦多項亞洲足協球會及國際賽事，最近的2026年國際足協東盟挑戰盃（第二級別）決賽亦已圓滿結束。憑借香港為內地與國際體育界搭建橋樑的獨特優勢，加上啟德體育園的世界級設施，他期待與中國香港足球總會及亞洲足協緊密合作，為香港帶來更多頂級國際足球盛事。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩、香港足總會長貝鈞奇及主席霍啟山亦有出席會面。
